verdicts.reason: A blows the '24 HOURS, 24 READERS' eyebrow up into a huge two-line orange block with an awkward '24 / READERS' break, so it competes with the headline and the body copy. Both candidates jam the Inkwell & Lantern logo into the far-left confetti strip, where it sits on a busy background and its 'LANTERN' text runs across the card edge. Both also have tiny, ragged fine print under the CTA. B keeps the eyebrow small and subordinate, so its hierarchy is cleaner, but the logo problem still needs fixing before it could ship.
